requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/342 of 21 December 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1153 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to the specific selection criteria and the details of the process for selecting cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy

requirements.requirement_text: A written declaration expressing willingness to support the project through a cooperation agreement, validated by a responsible institution in all participating Member States and, where relevant, non-EU countries, must be presented
requirements.applicable_entity: project promoters of renewable energy cross-border projects
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/342 of 21 December 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1153 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to the specific selection criteria and the details of the process for selecting cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy

requirements.requirement_text: The socioeconomic net benefits of a cross-border project in the field of renewable energy must be demonstrated by means of a cost-benefit analysis that covers all elements of point 3 of Annex Part IV to Regulation (EU) 2021/1153
requirements.applicable_entity: project promoters of renewable energy cross-border projects
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/342 of 21 December 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1153 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to the specific selection criteria and the details of the process for selecting cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy

requirements.requirement_text: Cross-border projects must always include a renewables generation facility as an integral part of the project
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/342 of 21 December 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1153 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to the specific selection criteria and the details of the process for selecting cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy

requirements.requirement_text: Cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy must comply with the applicable legal requirements on sustainability, greenhouse gas-emission savings, as well as the principle of 'do no significant harm' in accordance with Article 17 of Regulation (EU) 2020/852
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/342 of 21 December 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1153 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to the specific selection criteria and the details of the process for selecting cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy

requirements.requirement_text: All relevant provisions under Union legislation, notably on sustainability of bioenergy, capacity allocation at the borders, unbundling, competition and state aid, biodiversity and environmental protection must be fully respected
requirements.law_title: Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2022/342 of 21 December 2021 supplementing Regulation (EU) 2021/1153 of the European Parliament and of the Council with regard to the specific selection criteria and the details of the process for selecting cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy

requirements.requirement_text: The Commission shall review the list of cross-border projects in the field of renewable energy every 2 years
requirements.deadline_text: every 2 years
